learning_outcomes.text: To gain knowledge about the chemical industry.
To learn the principles underlying approaches and basic operations in the chemical production process.
To comprehend and internalize professional ethical criteria and professional rights.
To learn new developments and technologies and make a healthier career plan.
Ability to prepare projects related to Chemical Engineering work areas in individual and interdisciplinary teams.

syllabus_topics: Trends and New Technologies in Chemical Engineering
Chemical Engineering Approaches to Chemical Processes: Basic Operations and Separation Processes, Reactors
Dimensions and Units, Dimensionless Numbers and Dimensional Analysis
Principles of Mass and Energy Conservation, First Law of Thermodynamics
Graphical Representation of Chemical Processes: Flow Diagrams
Ethics in Chemical Engineering and Professional Rights of Chemical Engineers
Preparation and Presentation of a Research Project on a Selected Chemical Production Process
bibliography: Kenneth A. Solen, John N. Harb, Introduction to Chemical Engineering, Wiley (Pandora Bookstore)
Walter L. Badger and Julius T. Banchero, Introduction to Chemical Engineering, McGraw-Hill Int. Ed., Singapore.
